dedupe_keys.name: global unhas routes wfp sdi t logistics database humanitarian air service passenger and cargo routes 2014

description: This line layer maps the routes flown by the United Nations Humanitarian Air Service (UNHAS), which carries passengers and cargo for humanitarian and development agencies and their non-governmental partners to places that are hard to reach by road. It is part of the Logistics Database of WFP's Spatial Data Infrastructure for Transport (SDI-T), maintained with the Logistics Cluster, and was released on 14 October 2014. The layer is served from WFP's GeoNode as zipped shapefiles and GeoJSON through a web feature service, with an attribute metadata text file on the Humanitarian Data Exchange. It is free to use without registration under a Creative Commons Attribution Share-Alike licence. Coverage is global, limited to the countries where UNHAS operated in 2014. Caveats: the metadata note that blank or zero attributes had no data at release, the routes reflect 2014 operations and are not updated, and the GeoNode links may no longer respond. Simulation uses: air connections that keep relief staff and supplies moving when roads are cut, for humanitarian logistics network models. Related records: the WFP SDI-T logistics database layers (data-wfp-logistics-database-sdi-t) hold bridges, border crossings and obstacles from the same database.
